author: MrShiruba
what_it_is: 100% save, everything unlocked : Stamp mode cleared in hardest difficulty (Chat color unlocked), Mission mode fully completed (every icon unlocked), every game unlocked and won 15 times (every design unlocked).

gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.duc) Game Save (Europe)

format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header written by a converter ('Converted Savegame' / 'Savegame', ASCII 'shuny conv'), then 256 KiB raw for the 8 KiB EEPROM (cut 262144 -> 8192; the rest was all 0xFF)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-ards.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 8192 --stem '42 All-Time Classics (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)' --out DIR: drops the Action Replay header; fits it to the 8192-byte chip (cut 262144 -> 8192; the rest was all 0xFF) and writes each core's file
